quotes.text: skip-if = ["enterprise"] # First run disabled on enterprise builds

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch removes skip-if=["debug"] from DEFAULT in both account browser manifests. Accepted source keeps both manifests registered and retains separate per-test enterprise/Windows exceptions. The change restores debug-build eligibility under these defaults; it does not prove that every account test ran or passed or that all other selectors disappeared.
title: Removing the account manifest debug skip restores selection rather than proving passes
